member.name: T:MindAttic.Ideas.Abstractions.UsesAttribute
member.summary: Declares a citizen this COMPILED Page/Theme references BY STRING ID at runtime (via ) but does NOT compile against. Repeatable. The reflection-only packer emits each one into the manifest's uses[], so the host can (1) hoist the referenced citizen's css/js into <head> for this compiled page, (2) warn at install when a declared dependency is not installed, and (3) reference-guard it against deletion. This is the declarative dependency model (Orchard-style): a page never compile-references another package, it names what it uses. 0 = float to the latest enabled version.

member.name: T:MindAttic.Ideas.Abstractions.PluginBase
member.summary:
Base for a Plugin: a site-wide .idea that activates a behavior or capability across the entire rendered page without occupying a specific token position. Plugins are selected per-page via the Admin Page Properties Plugin checkbox list; they may also be dropped inline via <Plugin.X /> for one-off pages. e.g. dropping MindAttic.Ideas.Plugin.Tooltip.V1 loads tooltip css/js so ANY element with data-tooltip/data-tt shows a tooltip on hover.
By default renders no markup — emits as <link> and as <script>. Override BuildRenderTree to add markup. Declare typed [Parameter] properties for configuration; unmatched attributes land in .

member.name: T:MindAttic.Ideas.Abstractions.ComponentBase
member.summary:
Base for a Component: an inline-placed .idea that renders at the exact <Component.X /> tag position in the page body. Components can nest other Components, enabling composite UIs — e.g. MindAttic.Ideas.Component.TabControl nests Component.TabButtonContainer, Component.TabButton instances, Component.TabPageContainer, and Component.TabPage instances (each of which may contain Component.Textbox or other children). Declare sub-component dependencies with [Uses]/uses[].
NOTE: ComponentBase here is MindAttic.Ideas.Abstractions.ComponentBase, NOT Blazor's Microsoft.AspNetCore.Components.ComponentBase — the MindAttic kind wins the bare name. Blazor's base is aliased as BlazorComponentBase in this file (see MAI-A26, MAI-A10).
